Use Athervast as faraway elite-center context, not an active one-shot destination and not a Keystone source. It is marketed as safe because the cost of safety is pushed outward. A dazzling spiral metropolis of gold-capped towers, sky-illusion entertainment rings, potion manufactories, elite comfort, and lower-ring labor.; introduce it with a sensory palette, who feels safe there, and what has been neglected. Fearspends: A hundred-foot smiling mascot drifts above tired workers. A public promise of safety sounds expensive before it sounds kind.
Spoilers: GM-only location fields, combat notes, canon notes, and hidden-truth context stay off the player display.
